verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an SFU or relay architecture, and never describes per-participant track subscription. The Network Bandwidth Profile API only prioritizes participant video tracks, which is an adjacent control rather than selective forwarding of subscribed tracks. The Rooms API mentions a room 'type' and TURN configuration without saying how media is routed, and old community comments describe a 4-way peer-to-peer mesh instead.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, media routes through a selective forwarding unit or relay that delivers only the tracks each participant subscribes to
